Associate Product Manager - B2B SaaS
Wingify (VWO)
Gurugram, Delhi NCR, India (Hybrid)

About Wingify:
Wingify makes VWO, the market-leading A/B testing and conversion optimization platform.

Responsibilities:
• Own integrations and developer tools on the VWO testing platform.
• Author PRDs, manage backlog in Jira, and conduct customer discovery sessions.
• Monitor product health, churn, and A/B testing adoption metrics using SQL.

Requirements:
• 2-3 years experience in product management, preferably in B2B SaaS.
• Familiarity with web technologies, REST APIs, and A/B testing frameworks.
• Bachelor's degree in engineering.
